units: SI: m, kg, s, N, Pa; frequencies in Hz
scope: Right semi-wing structural FE model; aspect ratio 9 aircraft benchmark

properties.stiffeners: Equivalent anisotropic smeared stiffness; no discrete beam/stringer substitution

boundary_conditions.instruction: Retain every source SPC and RBE2/RBE3 equation. The source is not described adequately by a replacement root clamp.

included_mass.structural_mass: Use the original MAT2/PSHELL density data and nonstructural-mass fields, without resizing or rescaling
included_mass.mass_rounding: Nominal engine comment says 7500 kg; exact 13-card sum is 7501 kg. Retain exact source values.
included_mass.design_weight_factor: Design-specification weight factors are aircraft bookkeeping; do not apply them again to the FE deck.

SOL101.combination: 1.0 times aerodynamic FORCE set 1 plus 1.0 times gravity set 2
SOL101.aerodynamics: Use published cruise nodal forces directly; no new aerodynamic solve or coupled update

SOL103.mass: Original distributed and concentrated masses; COUPMASS=-1
SOL103.preload: No static-prestress request in original modal wrapper

flight_condition_context.meaning: Context for the author-provided cruise load file, not new inputs to recompute its force vectors
